segments.contextAfter: `completion`: The block to execute after the user dismisses the modal interface. This block has no return value and takes the following parameter: - **results**: An array containing the input from the user, or `nil` if the user canceled the operation. When an array is provided, the value in the array is usually an [`NSString`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Foundation/NSString) object representing the text input. The array can also contain an emoji image, packaged as an [`NSData`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Foundation/NSData) object. You can use the data object to create a corresponding [`UIImage`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/UIKit/UIImage) object.
